name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a U.S.-based junior gold explorer focused on the Lapon Canyon Gold Project near Yerington, Nevada, where 2025 drilling returned intercepts of 3.97 g/t Au over 85 metres. The company also acquires mineral royalties and precious metals streaming interests across Nevada and Idaho. It is in the exploration stage with an active 2026 reverse circulation drill program underway at Lapon Canyon.
